summary: This Form 8-K filed by Barclays Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC on behalf of BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2025-5C34 reports the removal of Greystone Servicing Company LLC as special servicer of the Soho House Chicago Mortgage Loan (3.7% of the asset pool) and the appointment of CWCapital Asset Management LLC as successor special servicer under the existing pooling and servicing agreement. No price, premium, or structural change to the trust is involved. This is a routine servicing update, not a special situation category.
